title: Physics Cutting: Balancing Detection, Performance, and Precision
subtitle: A deep dive into physics cutting mechanisms, covering collision box, ray, and grid detection strategies. It details rigid and soft body slicing approaches and analyzes dynamic precision balancing based on cut count and physics budget, offering direct solutions to common issues like stuttering and clipping.
